milestone.title: Test suite gap closure: kill stubs, harden CI, add missing workflow coverage

intent.outcome: Every test file in crates/mp/tests/ asserts real behavior or is deleted. CI gates merge on fixtures and scenarios. Core agent/human workflows have integration coverage. raul can be tested against ephemeral plans without coupling to dogfood state.

problem.description: Despite M28/M47 test hardening, review found the suite gives false confidence in several areas. Seven integration test files are compile-only stubs (concurrency, note, idea_dup, hybrid_session_path, session_branch, session_focus_path, schema_validate) — they pass cargo test but assert nothing. Two top-level commands have zero coverage: mp digest and mp uninstall. Secondary agent workflows are thin: track start/cancel/archive, backlog resolve, milestone defer/reopen/unblock/question, step split/fail. All 12 golden scenarios are read-only — no write-path regression on fixtures. CI runs mp validate, test-fixtures, and test-scenarios with continue-on-error: true — regressions can merge unnoticed. raul integration tests hit the live dogfood ./master-plan/ plan (no TempDir TestEnv) — plan edits break unrelated raul tests; raul_backlog_list_runs flakiness is tracked in M63 but raul lacks isolated fixture tests generally. ~14 legacy batch test files (p4_, ws_, m07_) violate AGENTS.md capability naming and duplicate narrower tests.

in_scope: Delete or implement all 7 compile-only stub test files — each must assert behavior or be removed
Add tests for mp digest and mp uninstall
Add integration tests for track lifecycle (start, cancel), backlog resolve, milestone defer/reopen (pick highest-value 3 flows)
Add 2-3 golden write scenarios on fixtures (init → create milestone → step add chain → validate)
Remove continue-on-error from plan.yml for test-fixtures and test-scenarios (keep or tighten validate step)
Introduce raul TestEnv pattern (temp plan + MP_HOME) for at least status/show/path commands — reduce dogfood coupling

Audit and merge/rename worst legacy batch files per AGENTS.md naming convention (at least ws1/ws2/p13 brief duplicates → charter_edit/brief_import); document remaining debt in ARCHITECTURE or AGENTS.md if not all renamed in one pass
out_of_scope: Rewriting all 94 integration files in one milestone
M63 raul flaky test fix (owned by M63)

open_questions.question: CI plan.yml has three jobs with continue-on-error:true: (1) mp validate on live dogfood master-plan/, (2) make test-fixtures on static fixtures, (3) make test-scenarios on golden CLI output. Fixtures/scenarios catch code regressions in isolation; validate on dogfood can fail from plan-only edits unrelated to the PR diff. Which jobs should block merge?
open_questions.answer: Suggestion — phased: Phase 1 (M67 S6): remove continue-on-error from test-fixtures and test-scenarios only — they are deterministic and high signal. Phase 2 (new track or M67 follow-up): either drop continue-on-error on validate once dogfood is always clean, OR run mp validate against a pinned fixture project instead of live master-plan/ so plan edits and code regressions decouple. Do NOT block on all three in one step without fixing validate input coupling first.
